_help: The List your project page for the Project Academy. The price and the application form link are set in config.js (academy).
title: List your project in the Academy
intro: Teach people what your project does with a short, playful course. They learn it, pass a quiz, and share a certificate in your colours.

benefits.title: People who actually learn your product
benefits.text: Tap through lessons and a quiz, not a banner people scroll past.

benefits.title: A Pro tag and a certificate in your colours
benefits.text: Everyone who passes gets one, with a Share on X button that tags you.

benefits.title: Checkable results
benefits.text: Every certificate has a code anyone can check at web3.toys/verify.

benefits.title: Made with you, in our style
benefits.text: You send the content, we turn it into a course that fits web3.toys.

checklistLine: We only list projects that meet all of these. We check before a course goes live, and we can remove a course at any time.
checklist: A public team, or well known backers.
An audit or an independent security review.
A live product people can use today.
No promises of returns, anywhere in your course or marketing.
rules: Every course says "Sponsored course by [your project]. web3.toys does not endorse any token. Not financial advice."
No token, money or airdrop rewards for taking the course. The reward is the Pro tag and the certificate.
Courses run until the date you sponsor them for, then come down.
templateLine: This is exactly what we need from you. Fill it in and send it with your application.
applySoon: Applications open soon. Check back shortly.
